confidence_notes: Food anchors follow current Austin cost-of-living aggregates, which are slightly later than the July 2026 target. Wine is estimated from its local price relationship to beer. Accommodation is a holistic estimate; Austin's limited hostel supply and event-driven lodging prices add uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city used. Food and drink estimates use Austin price aggregates; accommodation reflects general Austin and Sunbelt lodging context.
